name: joshaik-orchestrator
description: Orchestrator linking Cognitive Services, Web API and GWorkspace (Joshaik)

scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix "../Cognitive Services" && npm run build --prefix "../Web API" && npm run build --prefix ./
scripts.test:all: npm run test --prefix "../Cognitive Services" || true && npm run test --prefix "../Web API" || true && npm run test --prefix ./ || true
scripts.start: npm run start --prefix "../Cognitive Services" & npm run start --prefix "../Web API" & node ./index.js || true
